name: Counterspell

casting_time.trigger: You see a creature within 60 feet of you casting a spell that has Verbal, Somatic, or Material components.

summary: Reaction: a spellcaster within 60 feet makes a Con save or its spell fails; a spent slot is kept.
text: Take this Reaction when you see a creature within 60 feet cast a spell with Verbal, Somatic or Material components. The caster makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the spell fizzles with no effect and the action, Bonus Action or Reaction used to cast it is wasted; if the spell was cast with a spell slot, that slot is not expended.
